item.title: Changelog: A New Look, a Better First Five Minutes, and Offline for Everyone
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was only three days ago, but this round touched almost every page in the app, so it might look like a different app the next time you open it.

item.title: Changelog: Reviewing Offline, and Reviews That Don't Wait
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was yesterday, so this one is short, but it’s about something I’ve wanted for a long time: reviewing anywhere. On a train, on a plane, in a basement café with no signal. Your reviews shouldn’t stop because your connection did. While I was at it, I made reviews faster for everyone, especially if you live far away from the server.

item.title: Changelog: Sentences for You, Scanning Pages, and Sharing Your Progress
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was only two days ago, but a lot has happened since. That post was about grammar. This round is mostly about sentences: finding good ones to learn from, and getting them out of the books and manga you already have. I’ve also changed how Momiji describes itself. It started as “learn Japanese from anime”, but what I actually want is for you to learn from whatever you love, and that could be a novel, a manga, a game or a show. Anime is still a big part of Momiji, but it isn’t the only way in anymore.

item.title: Changelog: Grammar, Trying Momiji Without an Account, and Articles
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was about the first few minutes of using Momiji. Two things were still missing. You had to make an account before you could see anything, and Momiji had nothing for grammar. Words and kanji only get you so far: if you don’t know what ～てしまう or ～わけがない is doing, knowing every word in the sentence doesn’t help much. So this round was mostly grammar, plus letting people try Momiji before they sign up.

item.title: Changelog: A Friendlier Start, Better Reviews and a Browser Extension
item.description:
What changed in Momiji since the last post

The last post was about sentence decks and getting Momiji onto its own servers. Once that was done I looked at Momiji the way a new person would see it, and it wasn’t great. You logged in to an empty dashboard, kana was hidden behind a tab on the kanji page, and the sidebar used different names than the pages it linked to. So most of the last few days went into the first few minutes of using Momiji, and into making the reviews feel like one app instead of four.

item.title: Changelog: Sentence Decks, Recommendations, Analytics and Momiji Goes Live
item.description:
What changed in Momiji this week

After the last post I said I would focus on one feature at a time, finish it, and get Momiji somewhere I would actually want to use every day. This is what came out of the last week or so. Most of it is one big feature (sentence decks), but a lot of smaller things got finished along the way.
